0.long_answer: Iron chelation therapy is recommended to manage iron overload in patients with alpha-thalassemia who require frequent blood transfusions. This treatment involves using medications such as deferoxamine, deferiprone, or deferasirox to bind and remove excess iron from the body. By chelating iron, these drugs prevent the harmful effects of iron accumulation, including damage to organs such as the heart and liver, which can result from chronic transfusions.
